note: Measured conical boattails behind a cylinder, jet off, zero angle of attack, and Jack's second-order theory, for hpr's boattail pressure drag and the base pressure behind a boattail (M1.8b3, ADR-030). Coefficients on the cylinder's cross-section. Values read from the reports' figures, with a reading uncertainty (questionable marks points a report itself doubts); geometry as the reports give it (length_ratio l/d, diameter_ratio d_b/d), or for Jack as area ratio and half-angle. All are U.S. Government works.
